summary.en: An opening fragment: a world before the name, the name stated and held, then one hero with a whole action arc, handed on to the features.
summary.zh: 开场片段：先给一个世界、不点名，再亮出名字并停住，然后只给一个主角、走完一整条动作弧，交给后面的功能段。

fits: The first 11–20 seconds of a product film or launch film that names the product and then shows its atomic unit (a card, an item, a module) before the features; any length of film after it.
notFor: Films that open on a problem or a question (use a problem slot first); cold opens with fast cuts (see cold-open); films under about 20 seconds in all, where hook and name should merge into one scene.

intent.en: A first impression in three steps: a world before the name, the name held, then the one thing the product is made of.
intent.zh: 三步建立第一印象：先给一个没点名的世界，再亮出名字并停住，最后给出产品由之构成的那一样东西。

content.en: A product name (≤ 16 chars); one image of many or of flow; one hero object (a card, an item, a module) with a whole action arc; 11–20 s before the features.
content.zh: 产品名（≤ 8 字）；一个表现“很多”或“流动”的画面；一个主角（一张卡、一项、一个模块）走完一整条动作弧；功能段之前 11–20 秒。

fits.zh: 产品片或发布片的头 11–20 秒：先点名产品，再在功能之前给出它的基本单元。

notFor.zh: 以问题或提问开场的片（先放 problem 槽）；快切冷开场（用 cold-open）；总长不到约 20 秒的片（钩子与名字该合成一场）。

pairs.note: the claim slot: the name stated once and held
the demo slot: one hero with a whole action arc

en: Hold the name at least 30 frames; a name that passes in a cut is not read.
One hero, not a crowd: a grid of features in the demo slot breaks the arc.
zh: 名字至少停 30 帧；一闪而过的名字读不到。
只给一个主角，不要一群：演示槽里放功能网格就破坏了这条弧。
